class nvitk.types.image.Image¶

Voxel data with a metadata dict, optional axis labels, and NumPy/CuPy interoperability.

Construction

  • Pass a NumPy/CuPy array (and optional metadata / axes / name / orientation).

  • Pass a path string or Path to load via nvitk.io.imageio.imread().

Behavior

Indexing and ufuncs return a new Image when the result is array-like. Use with_data() or take() to replace voxels while merging metadata safely.

property backend: str¶

"cupy" or "numpy" depending on self.data.

property modality: str | None¶

DICOM Modality (tag (0008,0060)), e.g. "PT", "CT", "MR".

property submodality: str | None¶

Series-level descriptor (series description / submodality), if recorded.

property rescale_type: str¶

Intensity units tag (default "DV"), upper-cased; e.g. "BQML" for PET.

property is_pet: bool¶

True when modality is a PET code (PT / PET).

property is_3d: bool¶

True for a 3-D volume (no time axis).

property is_4d: bool¶

True for a 4-D volume (e.g. a time series or 4D-flow stack).

property shape: tuple[int, Ellipsis]¶

Voxel-array shape as a plain tuple of ints.

property ndim: int¶

Number of array dimensions.

property dtype: Any¶

Voxel dtype of the underlying array.

property affine: numpy.ndarray | None¶

4x4 world affine from metadata['affine'] (float), or None if unset.

property spacing: tuple[float, Ellipsis] | None¶

Physical voxel size in mm per axis.

Prefers an explicit metadata['spacing']; otherwise assembles it from the per-axis x_res/y_res/z_res/t_res keys. None when no spacing information is available.

property temporal_resolution: float | None¶

Time between frames of a 4-D series (t_res), or None.

property dicom_tags: dict[str, Any]¶

Metadata entries that look like DICOM tags (excludes nvitk housekeeping keys).

_axes_after_indexing(key: Any) → str | None¶

Recompute the axes label string after __getitem__.

Integer indices drop their axis; slices keep it. Returns None (i.e. forget axis labels) whenever newaxis/None makes the mapping ambiguous, so we never carry a wrong axis convention forward.

__array_ufunc__(ufunc, method, *inputs, **kwargs)¶

NumPy/CuPy ufunc hook so np.* calls on an Image return an Image.

Image inputs are unwrapped to their arrays before dispatch; array outputs (including each element of a multi-output ufunc) are re-wrapped.
